place.name: Rainforest Ecological Train
place.description: The Rainforest Ecological Train or Waterfalls Train (Tren Ecológico de la Selva or Tren de las Cataratas) is a 600 mm (1 ft 11+5⁄8 in) narrow gauge train that runs through the forest inside Iguazú National Park in the north of the province of Misiones of Argentina. The line is 7 kilometres (4.3 mi) long and was built using rail track by French manufacturer Decauville.
